nativeZh: n. 工作, 劳动, 职业, 行为, 功, 作品, 成果, 产品, 工程
vi. 工作, 劳动, 做, 运转, 起作用, 被加工
vt. 使工作, 使转动, 开动, 使用, 经营, 使逐渐变得, 造成

senses.en: activity directed toward making or doing something
senses.zh: 旨在制造或做某事的活动

examples.en: she checked several points needing further work
examples.zh: 她检查了几个点 需要进一步的工作。

senses.en: a product produced or accomplished through the effort or activity or agency of a person or thing
senses.zh: 由人或事物的努力、活动或作用所产生的成果。

examples.en: it is not regarded as one of his more memorable works
examples.zh: 这不被认为是他更值得纪念的作品之一

examples.en: the symphony was hailed as an ingenious work
examples.zh: 交响乐被誉为是一部天才作品

examples.en: he was indebted to the pioneering work of John Dewey
examples.zh: 他感谢约翰·杜威的开创性工作

examples.en: the work of an active imagination
examples.zh: 活跃想象力的产物。

examples.en: erosion is the work of wind or water over time
examples.zh: 侵蚀是风力或水力在一段时间内造成的

senses.en: the occupation for which you are paid
senses.zh: 获得报酬的职业。

examples.en: he is looking for employment
examples.zh: 他正在寻找工作

examples.en: a lot of people are out of work
examples.zh: 很多人都失业了

senses.en: applying the mind to learning and understanding a subject (especially by reading)
senses.zh: 专注于学习和理解某个主题，尤指通过阅读。

examples.en: mastering a second language requires a lot of work
examples.zh: 掌握第二语言需要付出大量努力。

examples.en: no schools offer graduate study in interior design
examples.zh: 没有学校提供室内设计研究生课程

senses.en: (physics) a manifestation of energy; the transfer of energy from one physical system to another expressed as the product of a force and the distance through which it moves a body in the direction of that force
senses.zh: （物理学）能量从一个物理系统转移到另一个系统的一种方式，可表示为作用力与物体沿该力方向移动距离的乘积。

examples.en: work equals force times distance
examples.zh: 功等于力乘以沿力方向的位移。

senses.en: a place where work is done
senses.zh: 工作地点

examples.en: he arrived at work early today
examples.zh: 他今天很早就到了工作地点。

senses.en: the total output of a writer or artist (or a substantial part of it)
senses.zh: 作家或艺术家的全部作品，或其中相当大的一部分。

examples.en: he studied the entire Wagnerian oeuvre
examples.zh: 他研究了瓦格纳的全部作品。

examples.en: Picasso's work can be divided into periods
examples.zh: 毕加索的作品可以分为几个时期

senses.en: exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity
senses.zh: 为某种目的或出于必要而从事精神或身体工作

examples.en: I will work hard to improve my grades
examples.zh: 我会努力提高成绩的

examples.en: she worked hard for better living conditions for the poor
examples.zh: 她努力为穷人改善生活条件

senses.en: be employed
senses.zh: 受雇

examples.en: Is your husband working again?
examples.zh: 你丈夫又开始上班了吗？

examples.en: My wife never worked
examples.zh: 我妻子从未从事过有报酬的工作。

examples.en: Do you want to work after the age of 60?
examples.zh: 60岁以后你想工作吗?

examples.en: She never did any work because she inherited a lot of money
examples.zh: 因为她继承了很多钱她从不做任何工作

examples.en: She works as a waitress to put herself through college
examples.zh: 她靠做服务员挣钱支付大学学费。

senses.en: have an effect or outcome; often the one desired or expected
senses.zh: 具有效果或结果; 常常是期望或预期的效果或结果;

examples.en: The voting process doesn't work as well as people thought
examples.zh: 投票过程不像人们想象的那么有效

examples.en: How does your idea work in practice?
examples.zh: 你的想法在实践中如何运作?

examples.en: This method doesn't work
examples.zh: 这种方法行不通

examples.en: The breaks of my new car act quickly
examples.zh: 我这辆新车的刹车反应很快。（原文breaks疑为brakes。）

examples.en: The medicine works only if you take it with a lot of water
examples.zh: 这种药只有配合大量的水服用才起作用。（词典例句，不是用药建议。）

senses.en: perform as expected when applied
senses.zh: 使用时能够按预期发挥作用。

examples.en: The washing machine won't go unless it's plugged in
examples.zh: 洗衣机不插上电源就不会运转。

examples.en: Does this old car still run well?
examples.zh: 这辆旧车还运行顺利吗?

examples.en: This old radio doesn't work anymore
examples.zh: 这台旧收音机已经不行了

senses.en: shape, form, or improve a material
senses.zh: 给材料塑形、加工或改良。

examples.en: work stone into tools
examples.zh: 把石头加工成工具。

examples.en: process iron
examples.zh: 加工铁。

examples.en: work the metal
examples.zh: 加工这种金属。

senses.en: give a workout to
senses.zh: 使得到锻炼；训练。

examples.en: Some parents exercise their infants
examples.zh: 有些父母会让婴儿做活动锻炼。

examples.en: My personal trainer works me hard
examples.zh: 我的私人教练让我进行高强度训练。

examples.en: work one's muscles
examples.zh: 锻炼肌肉。

examples.en: this puzzle will exercise your mind
examples.zh: 这个谜题会锻炼你的头脑

senses.en: proceed along a path
senses.zh: 沿着一条路径前进

examples.en: work one's way through the crowd
examples.zh: 努力挤过人群。

examples.en: make one's way into the forest
examples.zh: 向森林里面走去。

senses.en: operate in a certain place, area, or specialty
senses.zh: 在特定地点、区域或专业从事经营活动

examples.en: She works the night clubs
examples.zh: 她在夜总会演出。

examples.en: The salesman works the Midwest
examples.zh: 这名推销员负责中西部地区的业务。

examples.en: This artist works mostly in acrylics
examples.zh: 这位艺术家主要用丙烯颜料作画。

senses.en: proceed towards a goal or along a path or through an activity
senses.zh: 走向目标或沿着一条道路或通过某项活动

examples.en: work your way through every problem or task
examples.zh: 解决每一个问题或任务

examples.en: She was working on her second martini when the guests arrived
examples.zh: 客人到来时，她正在喝第二杯马提尼酒。

examples.en: Start from the bottom and work towards the top
examples.zh: 从底部开始,向顶部前进

senses.en: move in an agitated manner
senses.zh: 以激动的方式移动

examples.en: His fingers worked with tension
examples.zh: 他的手指紧张地活动着。

senses.en: cause to happen or to occur as a consequence
senses.zh: 使某事发生或产生某种结果。

examples.en: I cannot work a miracle
examples.zh: 我无法创造奇迹

examples.en: wreak havoc
examples.zh: 造成严重破坏。

examples.en: bring comments
examples.zh: 引来评论。

examples.en: play a joke
examples.zh: 开玩笑

examples.en: The rain brought relief to the drought-stricken area
examples.zh: 这场雨缓解了受旱地区的困境。

senses.en: cause to work
senses.zh: 使工作；让……干活。

examples.en: he is working his servants hard
examples.zh: 他让仆人们辛苦地干活。

senses.en: prepare for crops
senses.zh: 为种植作物而耕作。

examples.en: Work the soil
examples.zh: 耕作土壤。

examples.en: cultivate the land
examples.zh: 耕种土地

senses.en: behave in a certain way when handled
senses.zh: 在处理或加工时表现出某种性质。

examples.en: This dough does not work easily
examples.zh: 这团面不容易揉制。

examples.en: The soft metal works well
examples.zh: 这种软金属很容易加工。

senses.en: have and exert influence or effect
senses.zh: 产生并发挥影响或作用。

examples.en: The artist's work influenced the young painter
examples.zh: 艺术家的作品影响了年轻的画家

examples.en: She worked on her friends to support the political candidate
examples.zh: 她努力说服朋友们支持那位政治候选人。

senses.en: operate in or through
senses.zh: 通过某种场所、渠道或手段开展活动。

examples.en: Work the phones
examples.zh: 忙着打电话联络。

senses.en: cause to operate or function
senses.zh: 使设备运转或发挥作用。

examples.en: This pilot works the controls
examples.zh: 这名飞行员操纵着控制装置。

examples.en: Can you work an electric drill?
examples.zh: 你能用电钻吗?

senses.en: provoke or excite
senses.zh: 挑衅或激怒

examples.en: The rock musician worked the crowd of young girls into a frenzy
examples.zh: 那位摇滚乐手把年轻姑娘们的情绪煽动得十分狂热。

senses.en: gratify and charm, usually in order to influence
senses.zh: 取悦并吸引他人，通常是为了施加影响。

examples.en: the political candidate worked the crowds
examples.zh: 那位政治候选人努力争取人群的支持。

senses.en: make something, usually for a specific function
senses.zh: 制作某物，通常用于特定用途。

examples.en: She molded the rice balls carefully
examples.zh: 她仔细地把饭团捏成形。

examples.en: Form cylinders from the dough
examples.zh: 把面团搓成圆柱形。

examples.en: shape a figure
examples.zh: 塑造一个形体。

examples.en: Work the metal into a sword
examples.zh: 把金属加工成一把剑。

senses.en: move into or onto
senses.zh: 移动到或进入

examples.en: work the raisins into the dough
examples.zh: 把葡萄干揉进面团。

examples.en: the student worked a few jokes into his presentation
examples.zh: 这个学生在演讲中穿插了几个笑话。

examples.en: work the body onto the flatbed truck
examples.zh: 费力地把那具尸体搬上平板卡车。

senses.en: make uniform
senses.zh: 揉匀；使均匀。

examples.en: knead dough
examples.zh: 揉面。

examples.en: work the clay until it is soft
examples.zh: 揉捏黏土，直到它变软。

senses.en: use or manipulate to one's advantage
senses.zh: 利用或操纵……为自己谋利。

examples.en: He exploit the new taxation system
examples.zh: 他利用了新的税收制度

examples.en: She knows how to work the system
examples.zh: 她知道怎样利用这套制度谋取好处。

examples.en: he works his parents for sympathy
examples.zh: 他设法博取父母的同情。

senses.en: find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of
senses.zh: 找到问题的解决办法，或理解其含义。

examples.en: did you solve the problem?
examples.zh: 你解决了问题吗?

examples.en: Work out your problems with the boss
examples.zh: 解决你和老板的问题

examples.en: this unpleasant situation isn't going to work itself out
examples.zh: 这种令人不快的局面不会自行解决。

examples.en: did you get it?
examples.zh: 你明白了吗?

examples.en: Did you get my meaning?
examples.zh: 你明白我的意思了吗?

examples.en: He could not work the math problem
examples.zh: 他解不出那道数学题。

senses.en: cause to undergo fermentation
senses.zh: 使发酵。

examples.en: We ferment the grapes for a very long time to achieve high alcohol content
examples.zh: 我们发酵葡萄很长一段时间 以达到高酒精含量

examples.en: The vintner worked the wine in big oak vats
examples.zh: 酿酒师在大型橡木桶中发酵葡萄酒。

senses.en: go sour or spoil
senses.zh: 变酸或变质。

examples.en: The milk has soured
examples.zh: 牛奶已经酸了

examples.en: The wine worked
examples.zh: 葡萄酒发酵了。

examples.en: The cream has turned--we have to throw it out
examples.zh: 奶油变质了——我们得把它扔掉。

senses.en: arrive at a certain condition through repeated motion
senses.zh: 通过反复运动逐渐达到某种状态。

examples.en: The stitches of the hem worked loose after she wore the skirt many times
examples.zh: 她多次穿过那条裙子后，裙边的缝线松开了。
